snapshot.text: Public system under strain from insecurity in much of the country. Universal health insurance benefits started in February 2026, and the government reports a 32% drop in malaria cases in 2025.

priorities.title: Universal health insurance
priorities.text: Benefits under universal health insurance began in February 2026.

priorities.title: Digital health map
priorities.text: A digitalised health map was central to the ministry's first planning council of 2026.
